description: Source code for an IDL file reader and validator, including parsing, validation, dependency resolution, and extended attribute validation for Blink IDL files.

classes.name: IdlReader
classes.description: Class responsible for reading, parsing, validating, and resolving dependencies for IDL files.

methods.name: validate_blink_idl_definitions
methods.description: Validates that the IDL file contains exactly one interface, dictionary, or exception, or only typedefs/enums, according to Blink IDL conventions.

methods.name: read_idl_definitions
methods.description: Reads an IDL file and returns a dictionary with component name as key and IdlDefinitions object as value, resolving dependencies if necessary.

methods.name: read_idl_file
methods.description: Parses an IDL file into an IdlDefinitions object, validates it, and optionally validates extended attributes.
